cat > /tmp/plot_shapley.py << 'PYEOF'
import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

data = json.load(open('/tmp/shapley_v3_result.json'))
methods = data['methods']
labels = ['Naive\nXCorr', 'Diff\nXCorr', 'Threshold\nOnset', 'Perm\nGranger', 'TY\nGranger']

r6 = data['main_result_6pair']
fpr_vals = [r6['fpr_shapley'][m] for m in methods]
fnr_vals = [r6['fnr_shapley'][m] for m in methods]
combined_vals = [r6['combined_shapley'][m] for m in methods]

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(14, 4.5), sharey=False)
x = np.arange(len(methods))
w = 0.6

colors_fpr = ['#d62728' if v > 0.1 else '#ff7f0e' if v > 0.01 else '#2ca02c' for v in fpr_vals]
colors_fnr = ['#2ca02c' if v < -0.15 else '#ff7f0e' if v < -0.05 else '#d62728' for v in fnr_vals]
colors_comb = ['#d62728' if v > 0.05 else '#2ca02c' if v < -0.05 else '#ff7f0e' for v in combined_vals]

ax = axes[0]
bars = ax.bar(x, fpr_vals, w, color=colors_fpr, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_title('FPR Contribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Shapley Value (FPR)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(y=0, color='black', linewidth=0.5)
for i, v in enumerate(fpr_vals):
    ax.text(i, v + 0.01, f'{v:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5)

ax = axes[1]
bars = ax.bar(x, fnr_vals, w, color=colors_fnr, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_title('FNR Contribution (6-pair)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Shapley Value (FNR)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(y=0, color='black', linewidth=0.5)
for i, v in enumerate(fnr_vals):
    ax.text(i, v - 0.015, f'{v:.3f}', ha='center', va='top', fontsize=7.5)

ax = axes[2]
bars = ax.bar(x, combined_vals, w, color=colors_comb, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_title('Combined (FPR + FNR)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Shapley Value (Combined)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(y=0, color='black', linewidth=0.5)
for i, v in enumerate(combined_vals):
    offset = 0.008 if v >= 0 else -0.015
    va = 'bottom' if v >= 0 else 'top'
    ax.text(i, v + offset, f'{v:.3f}', ha='center', va=va, fontsize=7.5)

fig.suptitle(f'Shapley Method Contribution Analysis (v3: {data["n_null_experiments"]} null + {data["n_signal_experiments"]} signal experiments, FDR-corrected)',
             fontsize=11, y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/tmp/shapley_method_contribution.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.savefig('/tmp/shapley_method_contribution.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
print("Figures saved")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/plot_shapley.py
